Lessons.Title: Multiplicity
ExplanationParagraphs: Source-aligned goals: Comprehend the effect that the multiplicity of factors has on the shape of the graph of a polynomial function. Use zeros and multiplicities to create a rough graph of a polynomial function given in factored form.

If a factored polynomial contains (x-a)^m, the root a has multiplicity m. At an odd-multiplicity real root the sign generally changes and the curve crosses the axis; at even multiplicity the graph touches and turns without a sign change. Leading sign and total degree govern end behaviour.
